item.title: Bipartisan bill requiring warrants for license plate reader searches moves forward in Colorado
item.description: Striking the balance between privacy and technology is at the heart of a Colorado bill centered on the data collected by automatic license plate readers, according to those behind the legislation.

item.title: Colorado tourists escape Puerto Vallarta after cartel violence shuts down roads, halts flights
item.description: Passengers aboard a flight from Puerto Vallarta landed safely at DIA Monday after the Mexican military killed the leader of the country's most powerful drug cartel, triggering widespread violence.

item.title: Family of man killed by Aurora police intends to sue city for wrongful death, emotional distress
item.description: The family of Rajon Belt-Stubblefield, a man shot and killed by an Aurora police officer following a traffic stop last August, has announced plans to sue the city of Aurora for wrongful death.
